title: Integrative Genetic and Single-Cell Analysis Reveals Macrophages as Key Mediators Linking Aging and Osteoporosis
summary: Macrophages and TGFB1/HNRNPUL1 were implicated in the aging–osteoporosis association. Supported by integrated GWAS/single-cell analyses, age-associated macrophage proportions, and external human marrow validation; mechanistic causality is not experimentally established. The macrophage-centered result was present in medRxiv v1 on 2026-09-13 before the November journal version; mechanistic causality was not experimentally established.
